answer: Each identity takes a berth at a public jetty and locks a 70-credit census bond. At the census zenith hour, each identity must show a fresh key-signed timber receipt for work. A missing, copied, or rented receipt burns the bond. The fee grows with the roll: the k-th identity pays 36+6(k-1) credits. First fake 36, 1,000th 6,030; 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 36 once and keeps its share.
